candidate_rule: two non-promoted candidates per record: verified official fact or deterministic rounded-snapshot metric, plus explicit scope guard

scope_guards.long_horizon_snapshot: October 2025 and July 2026 BDUK values are rounded management-information snapshots limited to initial contract scope, with variable ingestion lag and scope revisions; derived long-horizon metrics do not establish exact-address completion, availability, orderability, physical delivery during the interval or milestone compliance.
scope_guards.missing_value: A contract absent from one displayed monthly table is preserved as absent for that snapshot. Missing month values are not imputed as zero, and calculations requiring both months are not performed.
scope_guards.gap_metric: A contracted-minus-built gap is an arithmetic relationship between two rounded snapshot fields. It is not a backlog forecast, parcel count or contractual milestone assessment.
scope_guards.evaluation_scope: The evaluation-plan page describes programme design and an evaluation approach; it does not establish delivery, availability or impact for a particular address.
scope_guards.checker_scope: Map Your Mobile combines crowdsourced and predictive information and provides estimates; it does not guarantee signal, indoor coverage or performance for a particular device, time or location.
scope_guards.complaints_scope: Ofcom complaint findings are aggregate regulator-received figures and rankings; they do not represent all complaints or determine an individual case's merits.
scope_guards.service_quality_scope: The customer-service page summarises industry research and includes data subject to restatement; it does not predict an individual customer's experience or exact-address service availability.
scope_guards.adr_scope: ADR KPI information describes scheme-level process performance and regulatory oversight; it does not determine eligibility, merits, timing or outcome for an individual complaint.

expansion_rule: For each contract in the union of the October 2025 and July 2026 tables emit eleven records. Contracts present in both months receive: presence classification, contracted delta, built delta, contracted percentage change, built percentage change or zero-base guard, average monthly contracted delta, average monthly built delta, October gap, July gap, gap change, and built increase as a percentage of the October gap or zero-gap guard. A contract present in only one month receives month-specific supplier/count/gap facts and explicit missing-month guards without imputation. Append 42 official evaluation, checker, complaints, service-quality and ADR records. Every fifth expanded record is REVALIDATION; all others are UPGRADE.
